cards.question: `window.scrollY`
cards.answer: Position of the top of the viewport in document coordinates.

cards.question: `window.scrollX`
cards.answer: Position of the left of the viewport in document coordinates.

cards.question: `element.getBoundingClientRect()`
cards.answer: Viewport-relative coordinates of the smallest rectangle containing the element's border box(es).

cards.question: Viewport coordinates in terms of document coordinates
Document coordinates in terms of viewport coordinates

`document.documentElement.scrollWidth;`
`document.documentElement.scrollHeight;`
cards.answer: Document's full scrollable dimensions, excluding scrollbars.

cards.question:
`window.outerWidth`,
`window.outerHeight`
cards.answer: Browser window dimensions, including toolbars, etc. (browser chrome).
